title: penv project settings
description: Project-wide configuration for project-env-utils (tracked in git).

name.description: Project identifier. Used as the namespace for local cache folders and the SQLite database.

op_item_prefix.description: Prefix prepended to every 1Password item title (e.g. 'myproj' → items named 'myproj/my-api'). Leave empty to use bare service names.

bucket.description: Bucket name used by external secret backends.

services.description: List of services managed by this project.

name.description: Service name — must match the repo folder name adjacent to the penv binary.

description.description: Human-readable description stored as the item note in 1Password.

env_vars.description: Key names shown in the show-info box and 1Password item template.

env_path.description: Path to the .env file relative to the service repo root. Defaults to '.env' when absent.

dev_ui.description: Configuration for the dev-ui tmux session.

repo.description: Repo folder name for the UI service.

pane_dev_cmd.description: Command run in the dev pane (e.g. 'npm run dev').

pane_sb_cmd.description: Command run in the Storybook pane (e.g. 'npm run storybook').

dev_backend.description: Configuration for the dev-backend tmux session.

sessions.description: Flexible grid sessions launched via 'penv dev-session'.

claude.description: Linked-window config that attaches an external tmux session window (e.g. a Claude Code session) into dev sessions.

session_name.description: External tmux session to link from.

window.description: Window name or index within the external session. Defaults to session_name when empty.

cmd.description: Command to run when the external session is auto-created on first launch.

repo.description: Repo folder name relative to repo_parent().

cmd.description: Command to run in the pane. Empty = idle shell.

repo.description: Repo folder name relative to repo_parent(). Empty = working dir stays at repo_parent().

cmd.description: Command to run in the pane. Empty = idle shell.

name.description: Window name shown in the tmux status bar.

panes.description: Panes to place in the grid. Gaps become idle shells automatically.

no_preset.description: Skip preset resolution and env sync — for sessions that don't use secrets.

message.description: Custom message shown in the infobox (word-wrapped), displayed above the notes section.
